details.root_cause_duplicate_ui: Duplicate branch returned the matched record metadata/validation without attribution; UI fell back from missing evidence_id to duplicate_reference, making EVD-013 appear to identify both the attempted upload and match. Legacy registry metadata had duration/container fields but predated metadata_extraction_status and stream fields. Duplicate uploads now probe the current temporary bytes, do not receive a new EVD ID, and display the matched ID only as Duplicate reference.
